about.title: Baking with care since day one
paragraphs: Al-Noor Bakery is a family-run bakery in Gulberg, Lahore. We bake every morning using fresh butter, real eggs and no shortcuts.
From a simple birthday cake to a full dessert table, we design every order around your taste and your budget.

testimonials.quote: The cake looked beautiful and tasted even better. Everyone at the party asked where it was from.

faq.q: How early should I order a custom cake?
faq.a: Please order at least one day ahead on WhatsApp. Simple cakes can sometimes be ready the same day.
We offer pickup from our shop. Message us on WhatsApp to ask about delivery in your area.
